div.l: And diascorides and eke Rusus
Olde ypocras haly A Galien
Serapion Razie and auicen
Auerois damascien ⁊and constantyn
Bernard and Gatesden and gilbertyn
Of his diete mesurable was he
For it was of no suꝑperfluite
But of gret norisshing and digestible
His studie nas but litel in the bible
In sangwyn and in perse / he clad was al
Lyned with taffata and with sendal
And ȝit he was but esy of dispense
He kepte that he wan in pestilence
For gold in phisik is a cordial
Therfore he loued gold in special
A good wyf ther was of biside bathe
But she was somdel deef ⁊and þᵗat was scathe
Of cloth makyng she hadde such an haunt
She passed hem of ypres and of Gaunt
In al the parissh wyf ne was ther noon
That to the offryng bifore hir shulde goon
And ȝif ther dide certeyn so wroth was she
That she was out of all charite
Hir coủerchiefs ful fyne were of grounde
I dorste swere they weyed ten pounde
That vp on a sonday were vpon hir hede
Hir hosen were of fyn scarlet rede
Ful streit y teyed / and shoos ful moiste and newe
Bolde was hir face / and faire and reed of hewe
She was a worthy woman al hir lyue
Housbondes atte chirche dore hadde she had fyve
Withouten other company in ȝowthe
But ther of nedeth nought for to speke as nowthe
And thries hadde she ben at Ierusalem
She hadde passed . many a straunge streem
At Rome hadde she ben / and at Boloyne
In Galice at seint Iame and at Coloyne
She couthe moche of wandryng by the weye
Gat tothed was she sothely for to seye
